items.title: Jane Fraser Set a New Course for Citigroup. It’s Working for Customers—and Investors.
items.summary: Jane Fraser isn’t the first CEO to try to turn around  Citigroup  But she might be the first to succeed where others have stalled. Fraser, 58, has recruited talent from competitors to help spearhead her strategy.

overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 61.81% annualised against 18.91% volatility (Sharpe 2.40) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. On a typical bad day expect losses near 1.90% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.49% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -10.97%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.

Persistence alarm: XOM have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
